'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Brazilian general election]]
**[[Brazilians]] vote in the [[Two-round system|second round]] of [[President of Brazil|presidential]] elections between incumbent [[center-left]] president [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] of the [[Workers' Party (Brazil)|Workers' Party]] and [[right-wing]] challenger [[Flávio Bolsonaro]] of the [[Liberal Party (Brazil)|Liberal Party]]. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-election-lula-bolsonaro-runoff-vote-president-e2c9fe8fc4aa3e3675b9a8ec15405d93 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-heads-polls-runoff-between-leftist-lula-bolsonaro-jr-2026-10-25/ (Reuters)]
**Lula wins re-election 52 to 48 percent, defeating Bolsonaro for a fourth non-consecutive term and becoming the first Brazilian presidential candidate to have placed second in the first round but win the second round. [https://www.reuters.com/live/brazil-election-live-lula-bolsonaro-face-off-presidential-runoff-2026-10-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Bulgarian presidential election]]
**[[Bulgarians]] vote in the first round of the [[President of Bulgaria|presidential]] election. Incumbent [[Iliana Iotova]] wins and will face former acting [[Prime Minister of Bulgaria|prime minister]] [[Andrey Gyurov]] in a second round due to record low turnout and no candidate having a majority of the vote. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/25/europe/bulgaria-presidential-race-heads-to-runoff-latam-intl (AP via CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/bulgaria-votes-president-wake-deadly-black-sea-drone-strikes-2026-10-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Serbian parliamentary election]]
**[[Serbians]] vote for all seats in the [[National Assembly (Serbia)|National Assembly]] in a [[snap election]], amid the [[2024–present Serbian anti-corruption protests|student-led protests]] against the incumbent [[United Serbia (2026 coalition)|United Serbia]] government. [https://apnews.com/article/serbia-election-students-vucic-fdf5def8a20aebc8ae139fd719478775 (AP)]
**The [[Student List]] wins the election, with former [[President of Serbia|president]] [[Aleksandar Vučić]] [[Concession (politics)|conceding]] defeat. [https://www.rferl.org/a/serbia-vote-election-parliament-vucic-student-corruption/33883844.html (RFE/RL)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/serbia-votes-students-seek-unseat-vucic-snap-election-2026-10-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[2027 French presidential election]]
**[[Marine Le Pen]] of the [[National Rally]] announces her [[President of France|presidential]] campaign. [https://www.reuters.com/world/frances-le-pen-launches-presidential-bid-protests-rattle-nation-2026-10-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**[[Venezuela]]n [[Venezuelan opposition|opposition]] leader and [[Nobel Peace Prize]] laureate [[María Corina Machado]] announces she has returned to Venezuela from exile. [https://edition.cnn.com/2026/10/25/americas/machado-returns-venezuela-latam-intl (CNN)]
